media.plainText:
muller's ptosis, miosis, anhidrosis
reverse ptosis= lower eye lid elevation
iris heterochromia= lighter iris color in congenital cases 

1. Central (1st-order) neuron= Hypothalamus → descends to lateral horn
ex. stroke, MS
2. Preganglionic (2nd-order) neuron= Ciliospinal Center of Budge; fibers exit and travel over the lung apex
ex. lung pancoast tumor, aortic aneurysm 
3. Postganglionic (3rd-order) neuron= Superior Cervical Ganglion → travels to the pupillary dilator and Müller's muscle
ex. cavernous sinus, painful and acute=carotid dissection

order: CBC, CT or MRI of chest and neck for lung tumor, MRA or CT angiography (CTA) of the head/neck for carotid dissection 
if carotid diseection order immediately, otherwise 1-2 days
